image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel installed on a vehicle. The wheel features a multi-spoke alloy rim with a dark metallic finish and a central logo cap. A rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing sidewall details but limited tread visibility due to the angle. The wheel is situated within a white wheel well/fender arch. The image has a sepia or desaturated color tone.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflection on the white body panel above the wheel appears slightly smeared and lacks sharp definition, typical of AI-generated reflections on curved surfaces.

The connection points where the spokes meet the inner barrel of the rim are somewhat ambiguous and 'mushy'. In some areas, the depth separation between the spoke face and the background barrel is unclear, suggesting slight geometric fusion.
The elliptical perspective of the tire seems slightly inconsistent with the rim's perspective; the tire bulge appears slightly exaggerated relative to the rim's flatness.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a car wheel and not a generic circle or other mechanical part.
To verify that the complex spoke structure is topologically sound and connected correctly to the rim without floating elements or fusion.
To ensure the wheel sits correctly within the fender arch with proper occlusion and depth relationships.
To assess the realism of reflections and material textures (rubber vs metal).

focus_areas: Reflection realism on the car body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'mushiness' of the inner rim barrel behind the spokes. AI often fails to render the negative space between spokes cleanly. Also, evaluate if the reflections on the car body match the lighting direction implied by the wheel highlights.
